summary.en: The trickster god who urged the gods to make the mortal world, then was slain and stripped of his heart.
summary.zh-tw: 說動眾神創造凡界的狡黠神祇，事成後遭眾神誅殺，心臟被硬生生扯出。

summary.en: Hortator of the Chimer who shared rule of Resdayn with the Dwemer; he fell after Red Mountain and is foretold to return.
summary.zh-tw: 奇莫的統帥，與鍛莫共治瑞斯戴恩，紅山之戰後殞落，預言說他終將轉世歸來。

summary.en: King of the Dwemer, who shared rule of Resdayn with Nerevar until both fell in the War of the First Council.
summary.zh-tw: 鍛莫之王，與尼瑞瓦共治瑞斯戴恩，最終與他一同死於第一議會之戰。

summary.en: Nerevar's retainer, corrupted by the Heart of Lorkhan; as the Sharmat he plotted beneath Red Mountain to remake the world.
summary.zh-tw: 尼瑞瓦的家臣，受洛克汗之心腐化，以夏瑪特之名蟄伏紅山，圖謀重塑世界。

summary.en: Dwemer Chief Tonal Architect who forged tools to tap the Heart of Lorkhan, seeking to lift his people beyond mortality.
summary.zh-tw: 鍛莫的首席音律工匠，打造工具汲取洛克汗之心，想讓族人超脫凡軀。

summary.en: Warrior-poet of the Tribunal, raised to living godhood in Morrowind by the Heart of Lorkhan.
summary.zh-tw: 審判席中的戰士詩人，借洛克汗之心成為晨風的在世神祇。

summary.en: Nerevar's queen, who became the Tribunal's goddess of mercy and healing.
summary.zh-tw: 尼瑞瓦的王后，後來成為審判席中司掌慈悲與療癒的女神。

summary.en: Sorcerer-inventor of the Tribunal, who sought to fathom and remake the workings of the world.
summary.zh-tw: 審判席中的術士與發明家，窮究並試圖改造世界運轉的機理。

summary.en: Daedric Prince of dusk and dawn, patron of the Chimer, who cursed them after the Tribunal broke its oath.
summary.zh-tw: 司掌黃昏與黎明的魔族，奇莫的守護神，在審判席背誓後降下詛咒。

summary.en: The prophesied reincarnation of Nerevar, destined to defeat Dagoth Ur.
summary.zh-tw: 預言中尼瑞瓦的轉世，註定擊敗達格斯·烏爾。

summary.en: Atmoran warlord who returned with the Five Hundred Companions after the Night of Tears; honored as the first king of the Nords.
summary.zh-tw: 阿特摩拉的領袖，淚之夜後率五百勇士團重返天際，被尊為諾德人的首位國王。

summary.en: Slave who led mankind's revolt against the Ayleids and became the first Empress of Cyrodiil.
summary.zh-tw: 奴隸出身的女子，率人類推翻亞歷德，成為賽洛迪爾的第一位女皇。

summary.en: Alessia's god-sent champion, a ferocious warrior who cut through the Ayleid hosts like a storm.
summary.zh-tw: 艾萊西亞麾下的天降猛將，殺入亞歷德大軍如入無人之境。

summary.en: Dragonborn emperor who turned back the Akaviri invasion and founded the Second Empire.
summary.zh-tw: 身為龍裔的皇帝，擊退阿卡維爾入侵，建立第二帝國。

summary.en: Colovian king who made Talos his general and was murdered before he could be crowned.
summary.zh-tw: 統合賽洛迪爾西部的國王，任命塔洛斯為將軍，還來不及加冕便遭暗殺。

summary.en: Tiber Septim's Imperial Battlemage, who made the Mantella to power Numidium.
summary.zh-tw: 泰伯·賽普汀的帝國戰鬥法師，為驅動努米迪安打造了曼特拉。

summary.en: Founder of the Third Empire who united all Tamriel; after death he was worshipped as the god Talos.
summary.zh-tw: 第三帝國的開國皇帝，統一整個泰姆瑞爾，死後被奉為神祇塔洛斯。

summary.en: Septim emperor whose assassination by the Mythic Dawn unleashed the Oblivion Crisis.
summary.zh-tw: 賽普汀王朝的皇帝，遭破曉神教刺殺，湮滅危機由此爆發。

summary.en: Last heir of the Septim line, who gave his life as Akatosh's avatar to end the Oblivion Crisis.
summary.zh-tw: 賽普汀血脈最後的繼承人，化身阿卡托什、捨身終結湮滅危機。

summary.en: Daedric Prince of destruction and change, whose legions poured into Tamriel in the Oblivion Crisis.
summary.zh-tw: 司掌毀滅與變革的魔族，湮滅危機中率大軍湧入泰姆瑞爾。

summary.en: Emperor during the Great War, who signed the White-Gold Concordat and bought peace at the cost of loyalty.
summary.zh-tw: 浩大戰爭時的皇帝，簽下白金協約，換來和平卻失去民心。

summary.en: First-born dragon of Akatosh, the World-Eater, once cast adrift in time and fated to devour the world.
summary.zh-tw: 阿卡托什的長子，世界吞噬者，曾被放逐於時間之流，註定吞噬世界。

summary.en: Alduin's brother and once his lieutenant, who turned against him and taught the Voice to mortals.
summary.zh-tw: 奧杜因的兄弟，曾為其副手，後來倒戈，把龍吼傳授給凡人。

summary.en: Prophesied hero who defeated Alduin.
summary.zh-tw: 擊敗奧杜因的預言英雄。

summary.en: Jarl of Windhelm and leader of the Stormcloak rebellion, who slew the High King in a duel and lit the civil war.
summary.zh-tw: 風舵城的領主，風暴斗篷叛軍的領袖，在決鬥中殺死至高王，點燃天際內戰。

summary.en: Legendary Aldmer lord, the first to set foot on the Summerset Isles and founder of Firsthold.
summary.zh-tw: 傳說中第一位登上夏暮島的傲德莫領主，也是第一要塞的建立者。

summary.en: Thirteenth ruler of Ysgramor's line, who united Skyrim as one kingdom and warred on its remaining Snow Elves.
summary.zh-tw: 伊斯格拉謨一脈的第十三位君主，把天際統一為單一王國，並征討境內殘存的雪精靈。

summary.en: Ancient necromancer known as the King of Worms, said to have ascended to godhood in the Warp in the West.
summary.zh-tw: 人稱蛆蟲之王的古老死靈法師，據說在西方扭曲中登上神位。

summary.en: Daedric Prince of domination and corruption, who sought to drag Nirn into his own realm.
summary.zh-tw: 司掌支配與腐化的魔族，企圖把奈恩拖進自己的領域。

summary.en: Atmoran hero of the Dragon War, one of the three who cast Alduin out of time.
summary.zh-tw: 巨龍戰爭中的阿特摩拉英雄，把奧杜因拋出時間的三人之一。

summary.en: Atmoran warrior of the Dragon War, one of the three who cast Alduin out of time.
summary.zh-tw: 巨龍戰爭中的阿特摩拉女戰士，把奧杜因拋出時間的三人之一。

summary.en: Atmoran hero of the Dragon War who used the Elder Scroll that cast Alduin out of time.
summary.zh-tw: 巨龍戰爭中的阿特摩拉英雄，使用上古卷軸把奧杜因拋出時間。

summary.en: Aldmeri prophet who led his followers out of Summerset to Resdayn; they became the Chimer.
summary.zh-tw: 帶領追隨者離開夏暮島、前往瑞斯戴恩的傲德莫先知；他的追隨者成了奇莫。

summary.en: First king of all Valenwood and founder of the Camoran Dynasty, in 1E 0.
summary.zh-tw: 第一位統治全威木的國王，第一紀元 0 年建立卡莫蘭王朝。

summary.en: Commander of the Direnni forces at the Battle of Glenumbra Moors.
summary.zh-tw: 格倫布拉荒原之戰中統領迪仁尼軍隊的將領。

summary.en: Direnni enchantress whose magic turned the Battle of Glenumbra Moors.
summary.zh-tw: 迪仁尼氏族的女附魔師，她的魔法扭轉了格倫布拉荒原之戰。

summary.en: Son of Frandar Hunding, who persuaded his father to lead the War of the Singers.
summary.zh-tw: 弗蘭達·亨丁之子，說服父親領導劍歌者之戰。

summary.en: Greatest of the Yokudan sword-singers, who won the War of the Singers and led his people to Hammerfell.
summary.zh-tw: 最偉大的尤庫達劍歌者，贏得劍歌者之戰，帶領族人前往落錘。

summary.en: Yokudan grandee who sailed into the Iliac Bay and founded Sentinel.
summary.zh-tw: 駛入伊利亞克灣、建立哨兵城的尤庫達貴族。

summary.en: King of Anvil and Baron-Admiral of the All Flags Navy.
summary.zh-tw: 安維爾國王，聯合海軍的海軍統帥。

summary.en: Altmer wizard said to have helped Tamriel against the Thrassian Plague; later revered as a god of magic.
summary.zh-tw: 相傳曾助泰姆瑞爾對抗色雷司瘟疫的高精靈法師，後世奉為魔法之神。

summary.en: Last emperor of the Reman Dynasty, assassinated in 1E 2920.
summary.zh-tw: 雷曼王朝的最後一位皇帝，第一紀元 2920 年遇刺。

summary.en: Crown prince, son of Reman III, murdered in 1E 2920.
summary.zh-tw: 雷曼三世之子、皇太子，第一紀元 2920 年遇害。

summary.en: Akaviri Potentate who ruled the empire from 1E 2920 to 2E 324.
summary.zh-tw: 阿卡維爾大領主，第一紀元 2920 年至第二紀元 324 年統治帝國。

summary.en: Former Psijic who founded the Mages Guild and became its first Arch-Mage.
summary.zh-tw: 出身賽伊克教團，創立法師公會，成為第一任首席法師。

summary.en: Master of the Psijic Order who trained Vanus Galerion.
summary.zh-tw: 賽伊克教團的大師，瓦努斯·加列昂的老師。

summary.en: King of Firsthold who approved the charter of the Mages Guild.
summary.zh-tw: 第一要塞的國王，批准了法師公會的章程。

summary.en: Legendary mage of the First Era, the first to claim the title of Arch-Mage.
summary.zh-tw: 第一紀元的傳奇法師，第一位自稱首席法師的人。

summary.en: Kinsman of Versidue-Shaie, called the Iron, who founded the Fighters Guild.
summary.zh-tw: 貝西多·夏爾的族人，人稱「鐵人」，創立戰士公會。

summary.en: Son of Versidue-Shaie and the last Potentate, assassinated in 2E 430.
summary.zh-tw: 貝西多·夏爾之子，最後一位大領主，第二紀元 430 年遇刺。

summary.en: King of Kamal who invaded Skyrim and Morrowind in 2E 572.
summary.zh-tw: 卡瑪律之王，第二紀元 572 年入侵天際與晨風。

summary.en: Skald-King of Eastern Skyrim and first leader of the Ebonheart Pact.
summary.zh-tw: 東天際的詩人王，黑檀心協定的第一位領袖。

summary.en: Jorunn's twin brother, exiled after losing their duel for the crown.
summary.zh-tw: 約倫的孿生兄弟，爭奪王位的決鬥落敗後遭流放。

summary.en: Colovian lord who seized the Ruby Throne in 2E 577.
summary.zh-tw: 第二紀元 577 年奪取紅寶石王座的科洛維領主。

summary.en: Emperor of Cyrodiil killed by Varen Aquilarios in 2E 577.
summary.zh-tw: 賽洛迪爾皇帝，第二紀元 577 年被瓦倫·阿基拉里奧斯所殺。

summary.en: Wife of Leovic and then of Varen, empress regent after the Soulburst.
summary.zh-tw: 先後嫁給列奧維奇與瓦倫，靈魂爆發後攝政的皇后。

summary.en: High Chancellor of the empire, Clivia's father, one of Varen's companions.
summary.zh-tw: 帝國大臣，希利維亞的父親，瓦倫的同伴之一。

summary.en: Heir of Tiber Septim and second emperor of the Septim Dynasty.
summary.zh-tw: 泰伯·賽普汀的繼承人，賽普汀王朝第二位皇帝。

summary.en: The Wolf Queen of Solitude, who started the War of the Red Diamond to put her son on the throne.
summary.zh-tw: 獨孤城的狼心女王，為了讓兒子登基而掀起紅鑽戰爭。

summary.en: Empress captured and killed during the War of the Red Diamond.
summary.zh-tw: 在紅鑽戰爭中被俘遇害的女皇。

summary.en: Potema's son, emperor from 3E 121 until his death in 127.
summary.zh-tw: 波特瑪之子，第三紀元 121 年登基，第三紀元 127 年死去。

summary.en: King in Hammerfell who defeated Uriel III and became emperor.
summary.zh-tw: 落錘的國王，擊敗尤利爾三世後登基為帝。

summary.en: Brother of Cephorus I, king of Lilmoth, who fought Potema with an army of Argonians.
summary.zh-tw: 塞弗勒斯一世的兄弟、李爾莫斯國王，率阿爾貢蜥人對抗波特瑪。

summary.en: Bosmer claimant to the Camoran throne, betrayed by his adviser, the Camoran Usurper.
summary.zh-tw: 爭奪卡莫蘭王位的木精靈，被自己的謀士卡莫蘭篡位者背叛。

summary.en: Emperor during the Camoran Usurper's war, father of Uriel V.
summary.zh-tw: 卡莫蘭篡位者作亂時的皇帝，尤利爾五世的父親。

summary.en: Baron of Dwynnen who led the alliance that defeated the Camoran Usurper in 3E 267.
summary.zh-tw: 德維尼男爵，第三紀元 267 年率領聯軍擊敗卡莫蘭篡位者。

summary.en: Founder of the Mythic Dawn, said to be the son of the Camoran Usurper.
summary.zh-tw: 破曉神教的創立者，據說是卡莫蘭篡位者之子。

summary.en: Warrior emperor who died invading Akavir in 3E 290.
summary.zh-tw: 征戰四方的皇帝，第三紀元 290 年遠征阿卡維爾時戰死。

summary.en: Imperial Battlemage who imprisoned Uriel VII and ruled in his likeness from 3E 389 to 399.
summary.zh-tw: 帝國戰鬥法師，第三紀元 389 至 399 年囚禁尤利爾七世並假扮成他統治帝國。

summary.en: Jagar Tharn's apprentice, killed by him; her spirit guided the Eternal Champion.
summary.zh-tw: 賈加·薩恩的徒弟，被他所殺，亡靈引導永恆勇士。

summary.en: Daedric Prince of Order, once cursed to live as Sheogorath.
summary.zh-tw: 秩序魔神，曾被詛咒化為謝爾格拉。

summary.en: Daedric Prince of Madness, lord of the Shivering Isles.
summary.zh-tw: 瘋狂魔神，戰慄孤島之主。

summary.en: High Chancellor who ruled the Empire as Potentate after the Oblivion Crisis.
summary.zh-tw: 湮滅危機後以大領主身分治理帝國的大臣。

summary.en: Colovian warlord who took the Imperial City about 4E 22 and founded the Mede Dynasty.
summary.zh-tw: 科洛文的軍閥，約第四紀元 22 年奪取帝都，開創邁德王朝。

summary.en: Leader of the Reachmen who ruled Markarth from 4E 174 to 176.
summary.zh-tw: 邊峪人的領袖，第四紀元 174 至 176 年統治馬卡斯城。

summary.en: High King of Skyrim for nearly twenty-five years, father of Torygg.
summary.zh-tw: 在位將近二十五年的天際至高王，托依格的父親。

summary.en: High King of Skyrim, killed by Ulfric Stormcloak in 4E 201.
summary.zh-tw: 天際至高王，第四紀元 201 年被烏弗瑞克·風暴斗篷殺死。

summary.en: Widow of Torygg and Jarl of Solitude.
summary.zh-tw: 托依格的遺孀，獨孤城的領主。

summary.en: Imperial general sent to Skyrim to put down the Stormcloak rebellion.
summary.zh-tw: 派往天際平定風暴斗篷叛亂的帝國將軍。

summary.en: Dragon who carried the Last Dragonborn to the gate of Sovngarde.
summary.zh-tw: 載最後的龍裔飛到沉睡淨土入口的巨龍。

summary.en: Redoran councillor who settled Raven Rock in 4E 1 and ruled it until 4E 65.
summary.zh-tw: 瑞多然家族議員，第四紀元 1 年移居鴉石鎮，治理到 65 年。

summary.en: Ancient Nord vampire lord of the Volkihar clan, killed in 4E 201.
summary.zh-tw: 沃奇哈氏族的古老諾德吸血鬼領主，第四紀元 201 年被殺。

summary.en: Daughter of Harkon, a pure-blooded vampire sealed in a tomb for ages.
summary.zh-tw: 哈孔的女兒，被封在古墓中多年的純血吸血鬼。

summary.en: Wife of Harkon, who hid their daughter from him.
summary.zh-tw: 哈孔的妻子，把女兒藏起來不讓他找到。

summary.en: Snow Elf priest turned vampire who wrote the Tyranny of the Sun prophecy.
summary.zh-tw: 成為吸血鬼的雪精靈祭司，寫下太陽暴政預言的人。

summary.en: Nord Jarl of Markarth, overthrown by the Reachmen in 4E 174.
summary.zh-tw: 馬卡斯城的諾德領主，第四紀元 174 年被邊峪人推翻。

summary.en: Skaal warrior of Solstheim, daughter of the shaman Storn.
summary.zh-tw: 索瑟海姆的斯卡爾戰士，薩滿史東的女兒。

summary.en: Skaal shaman who gave up his people's secrets to Hermaeus Mora and died.
summary.zh-tw: 斯卡爾的薩滿，把族人的祕密交給赫麥尤斯·莫拉而喪命。

summary.en: Dragon in Apocrypha that served Miraak.
summary.zh-tw: 在晦明識界替密拉克效命的巨龍。

summary.en: Igrun-clan king of the first Orsinium, who fought the thirty-year siege until 1E 980.
summary.zh-tw: 伊格倫氏族出身的第一座奧辛紐姆國王，撐過三十年圍城，第一紀元 980 年城破。

summary.en: Breton king of Daggerfall who began the Siege of Orsinium; slain at Bangkorai Pass in 1E 973.
summary.zh-tw: 發動奧辛紐姆圍城的匕落布萊頓國王，第一紀元 973 年在邦科萊山口被殺。

summary.en: Leader of the Order of Diagna, shot down by Joile's archers mid-duel.
summary.zh-tw: 迪亞格納騎士團首領，在決鬥途中被喬伊爾安排的弓箭手射死。

summary.en: Orc hero who came late to Orsinium's defense and died in a duel ambush.
summary.zh-tw: 遲來增援奧辛紐姆的獸人英雄，在決鬥中遭伏擊身亡。

summary.en: Orc king who rebuilt Orsinium, then plotted against his chiefs and was slain in 2E 582.
summary.zh-tw: 重建奧辛紐姆的獸人國王，後來密謀屠殺族長，於第二紀元 582 年被殺。

summary.en: Kurog's mother, Grand Forge-Mother, and secret leader of the Vosh Rakh.
summary.zh-tw: 庫洛格的母親，沃什拉克的幕後首領。

summary.en: Malacath-worshipping chief of Fharun, Kurog's old friend, crowned king of the Orcs in 2E 582.
summary.zh-tw: 信奉瑪拉凱斯的法倫要塞族長、庫洛格的老友，第二紀元 582 年成為獸人之王。

summary.en: Orc chieftain who founded Nova Orsinium in 3E 399 and won it Imperial recognition.
summary.zh-tw: 第三紀元 399 年建立新奧辛紐姆的獸人族長，後來為它爭得帝國承認。

summary.en: High King of Hammerfell who kept the Empire out until his death in 2E 862.
summary.zh-tw: 落錘至高王，至死不讓帝國進入，第二紀元 862 年去世。

summary.en: Baron who led the Forebears in Hammerfell's civil war.
summary.zh-tw: 在落錘內戰中領導先祖派的男爵。

summary.en: Crown Prince of Hammerfell, killed at Hunding Bay in 2E 864.
summary.zh-tw: 落錘王儲，第二紀元 864 年死於亨丁灣之戰。

summary.en: Imperial admiral who won Hunding Bay and governed Stros M'Kai.
summary.zh-tw: 贏得亨丁灣之戰、出任斯圖爾斯·邁凱總督的帝國海軍上將。

summary.en: Redguard mercenary who led the Stros M'Kai uprising of 2E 864.
summary.zh-tw: 領導第二紀元 864 年斯圖爾斯·邁凱起義的紅衛人傭兵。

summary.en: Cyrus's sister, Prince A'tor's consort, who signed the treaty for the Crowns.
summary.zh-tw: 賽勒斯的姊姊、阿托王子的伴侶，代表皇冠派簽約。

summary.en: Sload necromancer on Stros M'Kai who betrayed Iszara.
summary.zh-tw: 斯圖爾斯·邁凱的蛞蟾人死靈法師，出賣了伊扎拉。

summary.en: King of Daggerfall who lost his life in the War of Betony in 3E 403.
summary.zh-tw: 匕落國王，第三紀元 403 年在貝托尼戰爭中喪命。

summary.en: King of Sentinel who started the War of Betony and died in it.
summary.zh-tw: 發動貝托尼戰爭並戰死的哨兵城國王。

summary.en: Son of Lysandus, crowned king of Daggerfall on Cryngaine Field.
summary.zh-tw: 利桑杜斯之子，在克林蓋恩原野加冕為匕落國王。

summary.en: Sorceress mother of Lysandus, who foresaw his death.
summary.zh-tw: 利桑杜斯的母親，預見兒子之死的女巫師。

summary.en: Camaron's daughter, wed to Gothryd to seal the Betony peace.
summary.zh-tw: 卡麥隆之女，嫁給葛斯萊德以締結貝托尼和約。

summary.en: Green dragon who sought the moons' power to become Akatosh's equal; slain at Dragonhold, 2E 582.
summary.zh-tw: 企圖奪取月之力量、與阿卡托什平起平坐的綠龍，第二紀元 582 年死於龍之要塞。

summary.en: Imperial envoy who seized Rimmen in the Frostfall Coup of 2E 576; killed in 2E 582.
summary.zh-tw: 帝國使節，第二紀元 576 年以霜落月政變奪下瑞曼，582 年被殺。

summary.en: Surviving daughter of Anequina's murdered king; crowned Queen of Anequina in 2E 582.
summary.zh-tw: 阿納奎那遇害國王倖存的女兒，第二紀元 582 年加冕為阿納奎那女王。

summary.en: Legendary Khajiit hero of the Merethic Era who sealed the dragons in the Halls of Colossus.
summary.zh-tw: 神話紀元的凱季特傳奇英雄，把巨龍封印在巨像殿堂。

summary.en: Black dragon, Kaalgrontiid's lieutenant, founder of the New Moon Cult; slain by the Dragonguard, 2E 582.
summary.zh-tw: 卡爾格隆提德的副手黑龍，創立新月教團，582 年被神龍衛所殺。

summary.en: Redguard swordmaster who refounded the Dragonguard in Elsweyr in 2E 582.
summary.zh-tw: 紅衛人劍術大師，582 年在艾斯維爾重建神龍衛。

summary.en: Red dragon, old enemy of Laatvulon, who allied with the Dragonguard against Kaalgrontiid; later served Tiber Septim as Nafaalilargus.
summary.zh-tw: 拉特弗隆的宿敵紅龍，曾與神龍衛聯手對抗卡爾格隆提德；後來化名納法利拉格斯替泰伯·賽普汀效力。

summary.en: Half-Imperial, half-Breton founder of the Society of the Steadfast; secretly the Ascendant Lord, killed 2E 582.
summary.zh-tw: 半帝國人半布萊頓人，堅定會的創辦人，暗中是飛昇教團首領，第二紀元 582 年被殺。

summary.en: Queen of the Altmer and leader of the Aldmeri Dominion during the Three Banners War.
summary.zh-tw: 三旗戰爭時期的高精靈女王，先祖神洲的領袖。

summary.en: High King of the Daggerfall Covenant during the Three Banners War.
summary.zh-tw: 三旗戰爭時期匕落公約的至高王。

summary.en: Son of Jorunn the Skald-King; represented the Ebonheart Pact at the High Isle talks.
summary.zh-tw: 詩人王約倫之子，代表黑檀心協定出席高島和談。

summary.en: Last Druid King of the Druids of Galen, who led them to the Systres around 1E 330.
summary.zh-tw: 蓋倫德魯伊最後一位德魯伊王，約第一紀元 330 年帶領族人遷居西斯忒斯群島。

summary.en: Systrean count, secretly the Ascendant Magus; killed at All Flags Islet in 2E 582.
summary.zh-tw: 西斯忒斯群島的伯爵，暗中是飛昇教團的首席法師，582 年死於全旗小島。

summary.en: High Kinlady of Skywatch of House Errinorne, Naemon's wife, the Veiled Queen.
summary.zh-tw: 艾林諾尼家族出身的天望城高階女族長，納埃蒙之妻，即蒙面女王。

summary.en: Ayrenn's younger brother and displaced heir; died at Elden Root, rose as a lich.
summary.zh-tw: 艾瑞恩的弟弟，失去王儲之位；死於艾爾登之根後被復活成巫妖。

summary.en: King of Valenwood who joined the First Aldmeri Dominion.
summary.zh-tw: 加入第一先祖神洲的威木國王。

summary.en: Altmer vicereeve, Naemon's devoted advisor, who raised the prince as a lich.
summary.zh-tw: 高精靈副總督，納埃蒙忠心的顧問，把王子復活成巫妖。

summary.en: Leader of the Eyes of the Queen.
summary.zh-tw: 女王之眼的首領。

summary.en: Bosmer cleric who died cleansing the Heart of Valenwood and rose as Silvenar.
summary.zh-tw: 淨化威木之心而死、復生為席爾文納的木精靈祭司。

summary.en: Imperial mage, Euraxia Tharn's son, who tried to corrupt the Mane.
summary.zh-tw: 帝國法師，尤拉西亞·薩恩之子，企圖玷汙鬃首。

summary.en: Mane of the Khajiit in 2E 582, possessed by the Dark Mane.
summary.zh-tw: 第二紀元 582 年的鬃首，曾遭黑暗鬃首附身。

summary.en: Lunar Champion, twin sister of Shazah.
summary.zh-tw: 月之勇士，莎札的雙胞胎姊妹。

summary.en: Lunar Champion, twin sister of Khali.
summary.zh-tw: 月之勇士，凱莉的雙胞胎姊妹。

summary.en: First Mane of Elsweyr, who revealed the Riddle'Thar in 2E 311.
summary.zh-tw: 艾斯維爾的第一位鬃首，第二紀元 311 年揭示「謎塔」啟示。

summary.en: Colovian general who occupied Arenthia in 2E 582.
summary.zh-tw: 第二紀元 582 年占領阿倫西亞的科洛文將軍。

summary.en: Psijic monk who fought the Daedric Triad and became acting Ritemaster after Iachesis.
summary.zh-tw: 對抗三魔神同盟的賽伊克教團修士，伊阿奇斯死後代理儀式長。

summary.en: Sea Sload sorcerer who bargained with the Daedric Triad for Summerset.
summary.zh-tw: 與三魔神同盟交易、想換得夏暮島的海生蛞蟾人術士。

summary.en: Former Psijic and Valsirenn's husband, who became Mephala's Earl in the Court of Bedlam.
summary.zh-tw: 前賽伊克教團成員、瓦爾希倫的丈夫，後來成為瘋囂宮廷中梅法拉的伯爵。

summary.en: Meridia's champion, the Golden Knight, who died restoring Dawnbreaker in 2E 582.
summary.zh-tw: 梅芮狄婭的勇士「金騎士」，第二紀元 582 年為恢復破曉者而犧牲。

summary.en: Ageless sorcerer-king of the Maormer, beaten in the War of the Isle.
summary.zh-tw: 不老的海精靈術士國王，在島嶼戰爭中落敗。

summary.en: Septim emperor from 3E 99 to 120, whose reign saw the War of the Isle.
summary.zh-tw: 第三紀元 99 至 120 年在位的賽普汀皇帝，任內發生島嶼戰爭。

summary.en: Hero of the War of the Isle who founded the Knights of the Nine in 3E 111.
summary.zh-tw: 島嶼戰爭的英雄，第三紀元 111 年創立九聖靈騎士團。

summary.en: Argonian vicecanon of Shadowfen in 2E 582, one of the three who governed the region for the Ebonheart Pact from Stormhold.
summary.zh-tw: 第二紀元 582 年影沼的阿爾貢蜥人監審官，與另兩人在風暴堡為黑檀心協定共治這個地區。

summary.en: Nord vicecanon of Shadowfen, kidnapped by skin-stealers in 2E 582.
summary.zh-tw: 影沼的諾德人監審官，第二紀元 582 年遭竊皮者擄走。

summary.en: Dunmer vicecanon of Shadowfen, wrongly blamed for the deaths at the Hatching Pools.
summary.zh-tw: 影沼的丹莫監審官，曾被誤認為孵化池慘事的元凶。

summary.en: Aldmeri Dominion alchemist behind the 2E 582 invasion of Shadowfen.
summary.zh-tw: 先祖神洲的煉金師，策劃第二紀元 582 年入侵影沼。

summary.en: Elder Councilor, once governor of Gideon, secretly High Priest of the Waking Flame.
summary.zh-tw: 上古議會議員、曾任吉德昂總督，暗中是覺醒之焰教團的大祭司。

summary.en: Reachman chief who took the throne of Cyrodiil with Mehrunes Dagon's help.
summary.zh-tw: 靠梅魯涅斯·大袞相助奪得賽洛迪爾帝位的邊峪人首領。

summary.en: Ally who pursued Emperor Leovic's secret and the Four Ambitions in 2E 582.
summary.zh-tw: 第二紀元 582 年追查列奧維奇皇帝祕密與四大野心的同伴。

summary.en: One of the Four Ambitions, Calia's twin, sacrificed by Vandacia at Fort Redmane.
summary.zh-tw: 四大野心之一，卡莉亞的雙胞胎兄弟，在紅鬃堡被范達西亞獻祭。

summary.en: One of the Four Ambitions, Destron's twin; drained Vandacia's power at Fort Redmane.
summary.zh-tw: 四大野心之一，迪斯特朗的雙胞胎姊妹，在紅鬃堡吸走范達西亞的力量。

summary.en: Dunmer merchant killed by Argonian rebels for refusing to renounce his faith; made a saint.
summary.zh-tw: 因拒絕背棄信仰而遭阿爾貢蜥人叛軍殺害的丹莫商人，後被封為聖人。

summary.en: Daedric Prince of the hunt, who leads a Great Hunt once each era.
summary.zh-tw: 司掌狩獵的魔族王子，每個紀元舉行一次大狩獵。

summary.en: Frost giant of Solstheim, called to Hircine's hunt in 3E 427.
summary.zh-tw: 索瑟海姆的冰霜巨人，第三紀元 427 年被召入海爾辛的狩獵。

summary.en: Imperial captain of Fort Frostmoth, called to Hircine's hunt; died in 4E 5.
summary.zh-tw: 霜蛾堡壘的帝國隊長，曾被召入海爾辛的狩獵，第四紀元 5 年去世。

summary.en: Chief of the Skaal and wielder of Hircine's Ring in 3E 427.
summary.zh-tw: 第三紀元 427 年斯卡爾人的首領，持有海爾辛之戒。

summary.en: Ayleid sorcerer-king and Meridia's champion; after Pelinal slew him, he returned in 3E 433.
summary.zh-tw: 梅芮狄婭的亞歷德巫王，被裴倫納爾擊倒後於第三紀元 433 年歸來。

summary.en: Nameless old preacher who warned of Umaril's return and guided the new crusader.
summary.zh-tw: 預告烏瑪瑞爾歸來、指引新聖戰士的無名老人。

summary.en: Arch-Mage from 3E 431 who banned necromancy and gave his soul against Mannimarco.
summary.zh-tw: 第三紀元 431 年起的首席法師，禁絕死靈術，最後以靈魂對抗曼尼馬克。

summary.en: Masked master of Cyrodiil's Thieves Guild, an identity passed down with Nocturnal's cowl.
summary.zh-tw: 賽洛迪爾盜賊公會的蒙面首領，這個身分隨娜克圖諾的兜帽代代相傳。

summary.en: Count of Anvil who vanished and led the Thieves Guild as the Gray Fox.
summary.zh-tw: 失蹤多年的安維爾伯爵，以灰狐身分領導盜賊公會。

summary.en: Imperial City watch captain who hunted the Gray Fox in 3E 433.
summary.zh-tw: 第三紀元 433 年追捕灰狐的帝都衛兵隊長。

summary.en: Thief who first stole the Gray Cowl from Nocturnal.
summary.zh-tw: 最早從娜克圖諾那裡偷走灰色兜帽的盜賊。

summary.en: Thalmor advisor at the College of Winterhold who tried to seize the Eye of Magnus.
summary.zh-tw: 派駐冬堡學院的梭默顧問，企圖奪取瑪格努斯之眼。

summary.en: Former College mage turned pure magic, dwelling beneath the College of Winterhold.
summary.zh-tw: 化為純粹魔法的前學院法師，住在冬堡學院底下。

summary.en: Arch-Mage of the College of Winterhold, killed by Ancano in 4E 201.
summary.zh-tw: 冬堡學院的首席法師，第四紀元 201 年被安卡諾殺害。

summary.en: Elderly Alteration teacher at the College of Winterhold.
summary.zh-tw: 冬堡學院年長的變化系教師。
